privacy.title: Your data
privacy.intro: Download a copy of the data we hold about you, or ask us to erase it. The same options apply to every player, wherever you live.
privacy.reasonHint: Only used to help us improve. It is deleted with the request.

download.title: Download my data
download.description: A JSON file with your profile, kingdom, battles and spy reports, messages you wrote, friends, alliance and payment records, and sign-in history. It leaves out passwords, security secrets, other players' private data and staff records. You can download once every 24 hours.
download.modalBody: Confirm it is you. The file is built when you press the button and is not stored on our servers.
download.failed: The download failed. Try again later.
download.rateLimited: You already downloaded your data today. You can download again after {{time}}.

erase.title: Delete my account and data
erase.description: We email you a link to confirm. Once you open it and press Confirm, your account is deactivated, and after 14 days it is erased: your email, name, avatar, bio and the messages you wrote. Sign in during those 14 days to cancel. Records other players or accounting rely on stay without your name. Supporter renewal stops when you confirm and resumes if you cancel while your paid time is still running.
erase.modalBody: Confirm it is you. We will send a confirmation link to the email on your account. Nothing happens until you open it and press Confirm.
erase.awaiting: We sent a link to the email on your account. It works once and expires {{time}}. Nothing is deleted until you open it and press Confirm.
